questions.question: The average runs of a cricket player in 20 matches is 30. If the average of the first 12 matches is 40, find the average of the last 8 matches.
questions.questionHtml: The average runs of a cricket player in 20 matches is 30. If the average of the first 12 matches is 40, find the average of the last 8 matches.
questions.solution:
Average = 30 and extra runs in first 12 matches = 12 × 10 = 120.
This means that the average of the remaining 8 matches will be less by 120 runs, only then the common average will be 30 
⇒ Total runs in last 8 matches =  30 -(120/8) = 30 -15 =15

= 36

questions.question: The average of 10 observations is 21. A new observation is included and the average of these 11 numbers is 1 less than the prevoius average. The 11 th observation is________.

questions.solution:

Average of 11 observations is 20 ⇒ 20 = (10x + x)/11 ⇒ x = 220 - 210 = 10

questions.question: The mean weight (in kg) of four students is 30 . The weights of three of them are 42 kg, 28 kg, and 24 kg. What is the weight (in kg) of the fourth student?
questions.questionHtml: The mean weight (in kg) of four students is 30 . The weights of three of them are 42 kg, 28 kg, and 24 kg. What is the weight (in kg) of the fourth student?
questions.solution:
Given:- The average weight of 4 students is 30 and weight of three of them are 42 kg, 28 kg, and 24 kg

To find:- Weight of fourth student

Formula used:- Average = \(\frac{sum\ of\ observation}{number\ of\ observation}\)

Calculation:- Let the weight of fourth student be x,

By using the formula of average-

⇒ \(30=\frac{42+28+24+x}{4}\)

⇒ 120 = 94 + x

⇒ x = 26

 

.·. The weight of fourth student is 26 kg

One of the numbers is excluded, the average becomes 20.

Average =  Sum of all observations/Number of observations

Total score of the class = 720 + 1440 = 2160

Average score of the class= 2160 ÷ 30 = 72

questions.question: A batch of 30 students took an intelligence test in an institution. 20 of them scored an average of 75 marks and the remaining students scored an average of 87 marks. What is the average score of the entire batch of students?

The first five even natural numbers

Average = Ratio of sum of the observations to the total number of observations  

Calculation:

so sum of first 5 even numbers = 5 × 6 = 30

Average = 30/5 = 6

questions.question: The average height of three kids is 56 cm and their heights are in the proportion of 7 ∶ 8 ∶ 9. Find the heights of all the three.
questions.questionHtml: The average height of three kids is 56 cm and their heights are in the proportion of 7 ∶ 8 ∶ 9. Find the heights of all the three.
questions.solution:
Given:

Average height of 3 kids = 56 cm

Proportion of heights = 7 : 8 : 9

Calculation:

⇒ Let the height of three kids be 7x, 8x and 9x.

⇒ \(\frac{7x+8x+9x}{3}\) = 56

⇒ \(\frac{24x}{3}\) = 56

⇒ x = \(\frac{56}{8}\) = 7

⇒ Height of first kid = 7 × 7 = 49 cm

⇒ Height of second kid = 8 × 7 = 56 cm

⇒ Height of third kid = 9 × 7 = 63 cm

Therefore, the heights of three kids are 49 cm, 56 cm and 63 cm respectively.

questions.question: A class of 30 students appeared in a test. The average score of 12 students is 62, and that of the rest is 72. What is the average score of the class?
questions.questionHtml: A class of 30 students appeared in a test. The average score of 12 students is 62, and that of the rest is 72. What is the average score of the class?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Ratio of number of students in the two groups = 12 : 18 ⇒ 2 : 3.

Let the assumed average of the class be 62 (the average of the first group).

Deviation of the second group from the assumed average = 72 − 62 = +10.

Net average deviation = (3 × 10) ÷ (2 + 3) = 30 ÷ 5 = +6.

Overall average = Assumed Average + Net deviation = 62 + 6 = 68.

∴ The correct answer is 68.

Alternate Method

Given:

Total number of students = 30

Average score of 12 students = 62

Average score of the remaining students = 72

Formula Used:

Overall Average = (Total sum of all scores) ÷ (Total number of students)

Calculations:

⇒ Number of remaining students = 30 − 12 = 18

⇒ Sum of scores of 12 students = 12 × 62 = 744

⇒ Sum of scores of 18 students = 18 × 72 = 1296

⇒ Total sum of scores of 30 students = 744 + 1296 = 2040

⇒ Overall Average = 2040 ÷ 30 = 68

∴ The correct answer is 68.

Additional Information

Weighted Average

When two groups with sizes N1 and N2 have averages A1 and A2 respectively, the combined average is calculated as (N1A1 + N2A2) ÷ (N1 + N2).

Deviation Method

To simplify calculations, select an assumed average. The overall average equals the assumed average plus the net deviation divided by the total number of observations.

Alligation Method

The ratio in which two quantities are mixed is inversely proportional to the differences of their individual averages from the overall average.

questions.question: The average of 15 numbers is 53. A number is removed and the average of 14 numbers now becomes 55. Which number was removed?
questions.questionHtml: The average of 15 numbers is 53. A number is removed and the average of 14 numbers now becomes 55. Which number was removed?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average of 15 numbers is 53.

The average of 14 numbers is 55.

Calculation:

Let's denote:

N = the number that was removed.

The sum of the initial 15 numbers can be calculated as 15 × Average = 15 × 53 = 795.

The sum of the 14 remaining numbers can be calculated as 14 × Average = 14 × 55 = 770.

The number removed is the difference between these two sums:

N = 795 - 770 = 25

So, the number that was removed is 25.

questions.question: In an examination, the average marks of 60 girls is 15 and the average marks of 40 boys is 30. The average marks of the group in which the boys and girls are taken together is:
questions.questionHtml: In an examination, the average marks of 60 girls is 15 and the average marks of 40 boys is 30. The average marks of the group in which the boys and girls are taken together is:

For girls, average Marks = Total Marks ÷ 60 ⇒ 15 = Total Marks ÷ 60 = 900

Total Marks = 1200 + 900 = 2100. Hence, the required average = \(\frac{2100}{60+40}=\frac{2100}{100}=21\)

questions.question: The average runs scored by a batsman in 7 matches is 49 and in other 9 matches the average is 27. What is the average runs scored by the batsman in these 16 matches?
questions.questionHtml: The average runs scored by a batsman in 7 matches is 49 and in other 9 matches the average is 27. What is the average runs scored by the batsman in these 16 matches?
questions.solution:
Given

Average runs in 7 matches = 49

Average runs in 9 matches = 27

Concept:

The total average is the sum of all runs divided by the total number of matches.

Solution:

Total runs in 7 matches = 7 × 49 = 343

Total runs in 9 matches = 9 × 27 = 243

Total runs in 16 matches = 343 + 243 = 586

Average runs in 16 matches = 586/16 = 36.625

Therefore, the average runs scored by the batsman in these 16 matches is 36.625.

questions.question: Average weight of 10 persons is 40 kg . A new person join the group and average weight of 11 persons becomes 42 kg . What will be the weight of new person?
questions.questionHtml: Average weight of 10 persons is 40 kg. A new person join the group and average weight of 11 persons becomes 42 kg. What will be the weight of new person?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

New Average = 42 kg, Old Average = 40 kg.

Increase in Average = 42 − 40 = 2 kg.

Total increase in weight for all 11 persons = 11 × 2 = 22 kg.

Weight of the new person = Old Average + Total Increase.

⇒ Weight = 40 + 22 = 62 kg.

∴ The correct answer is 62 kg.

Alternate Method

Given:

Average weight of 10 persons = 40 kg

Average weight of 11 persons (after new person joins) = 42 kg

Formula Used:

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

Calculations:

⇒ Total weight of initial 10 persons = 10 × 40 = 400 kg

⇒ Total weight of 11 persons = 11 × 42 = 462 kg

⇒ Weight of the new person = Total weight of 11 persons − Total weight of 10 persons

⇒ Weight of the new person = 462 − 400 = 62 kg

∴ The correct answer is 62 kg.

Additional Information

When a Person Leaves the Group

Value of the person leaving = Old Average + (Net Decrease in Average × Remaining Persons) OR Old Average − (Net Increase in Average × Remaining Persons).

Replacement in Average

When a new person replaces an existing one: Weight of new person = Weight of replaced person + (Net Change in Average × Total Number of Persons).

Combined Average

If two groups of sizes n1 and n2 have averages A1 and A2 respectively, then their Combined Average = (n1A1 + n2A2) ÷ (n1 + n2).

questions.question: The average weight of A, B and C is 65 kg. If the average weight of C and B is 61.5 kg, and the average weight of A and C is 68.5 kg, then the weight of C (in kg) is:
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of A, B and C is 65 kg. If the average weight of C and B is 61.5 kg, and the average weight of A and C is 68.5 kg, then the weight of C (in kg) is:

Average weight of A, B and C = 65 kg

Average weight of C and B = 61.5 kg

Average weight of A and C = 68.5 kg

Formula used:

Average = sum of weights/No of persons

Calculation:

Weight of A, B and C

⇒ (A + B + C)/3 = 65

⇒ A + B + C = 195

Weight of C and B

⇒ (C + B)/2 = 61.5

Weight of A and C

Weight of A

Weight of C

questions.question: The average height of 12 students of a class is 132.5 cm. If one more student joins, the average height becomes 131.2 cm. the height of the new student is∶
questions.questionHtml: The average height of 12 students of a class is 132.5 cm. If one more student joins, the average height becomes 131.2 cm. the height of the new student is∶
questions.solution:
Short Trick∶

Since new average height of students after a new student joins the class = 131.2 cm

∴ Height of new student = 131.2 cm

Difference in old average and new average = 132.5 – 131.2 = 1.3 cm

Since average height is decrease by 1.3 cm after a new student joins the class.

∴ Actual height of new student = 131.2 – (12 × 1.3) = 115.6 cm

Detailed Solution∶

Average height of 12 students = 132.5 cm

Total height of 12 students = 12 × 132.5 = 1590 cm

New average height of students after a new student joins the class = 131.2 cm

Total height of students after a new student joins class = (12 + 1) × 131.2 = 1705.6 cm

∴ Height of new student = 1705.6 – 1590 = 115.6 cm

questions.question: Class 10, consisting of 40 students, took a science test. 30 students had an average score of 95. The other students had an average score of 85. What is the average score of the whole class?
questions.questionHtml: Class 10, consisting of 40 students, took a science test. 30 students had an average score of 95. The other students had an average score of 85. What is the average score of the whole class?
questions.solution:
Given:

Class 10, consisting of 40 students, took a science test.

30 students had an average score of 95.

The other students had an average score of 85

Concept used:

Average = Sum of all values/ Total no. of values

Calculations:

According to the question,

Average of 30 students,

95 = Total Sum/30

⇒ Sum = 95 × 30 = 2850

Average of the rest of the 10 students,

85 = Sum/10

⇒ Sum = 850

Now the new average,

A = (2850 + 850)/40

⇒ A = 3700/40 = 92.5

∴ The combined average of all the students is 92.5.

questions.question: A family consists of a father, mother and son. The ratio of their present ages is 8 ∶ 5 ∶ 2 and the present age of the father is 48 years. What will be the average age of family after 3 years?
questions.questionHtml: A family consists of a father, mother and son. The ratio of their present ages is 8 ∶ 5 ∶ 2 and the present age of the father is 48 years. What will be the average age of family after 3 years?
questions.solution:
Mother's age = (5/8) × Father's age = (5/8) × 48 = 30 years and Son's age = (2/8) × Father's age = (1/4) × 48 = 12 years

After 3 years, their ages will be: Father's age = 48 + 3 = 51 years, Mother's age = 30 + 3 = 33 years, and Son's age = 12 + 3 = 15 years. Total age = 51 + 33 + 15 = 99

Average age = 99/3 = 33

P + K = 45 × 2 = 90 and K+ R = 35 × 2 = 70 

The weight of R = 30. On substituting the value K + 30 =  70 ⇒ K = 40

questions.question: In the 8th class, consisting of 30 students, a Mathematics test was taken. 10 students had an average score of 90. The other students had an average score of 75. What is the average score of the whole class?
questions.questionHtml: In the 8th class, consisting of 30 students, a Mathematics test was taken. 10 students had an average score of 90. The other students had an average score of 75. What is the average score of the whole class?
questions.solution:
Total students = 30

Score of 10 students: 10 × 90 = 900

Score of 20 students: 20 × 75 = 1500

Total score: 900 + 1500 = 2400

Average score = 2400 / 30 = 80

questions.question: In a class, the average score of thirty students in a test is 69. Later on, it was found that the score of one student was wrongly marked as 88 instead of 58. The actual average score is:
questions.questionHtml: In a class, the average score of thirty students in a test is 69. Later on, it was found that the score of one student was wrongly marked as 88 instead of 58. The actual average score is:
questions.solution:
Average score of 30 students = 69

Sum of score of 30 students = 69 × 30 = 2070

Correct sum of score of 30 students = 2070 - 88 + 58 = 2040

∴ Correct average score of 30 students = 2040/30 = 68

questions.question: The average weight of 10 parcels is 28.6 kg. The addition of a new parcel reduces the average weight by 0.6 kg. What is the weight (in kg) of the new parcel?
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of 10 parcels is 28.6 kg. The addition of a new parcel reduces the average weight by 0.6 kg. What is the weight (in kg) of the new parcel?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average weight of 10 parcels = 28.6 kg

Formula used:

\({Average}={The\ sum\ of\ the\ all\ items\over The\ total\ number\ of\ items }\)

Calculation:

Let the weight of new parcels be X

The sum of the all the items = 28.6 × 10 = 286

The new items = 28.6 - 0.6 = 28 kg

The sum of all the items with new items = 286 + X

⇒ \({28}={286+X\over11}\)

⇒ 28 × 11 = 286 + X

⇒ 308 = 286 + X

⇒ 308 - 286 = X

⇒ X = 22

∴ The required result will be 22 kg.

questions.question: The average of 24 numbers is 26. The average of the first 15 numbers is 23 and that of the last 8 number is 33. Find 16 th number.
questions.questionHtml: The average of 24 numbers is 26. The average of the first 15 numbers is 23 and that of the last 8 number is 33. Find 16<sup>th</sup> number.
questions.solution:
Formula used:

Average = (Sum of all values)/Total number of values

⇒ Sum of all values = (Average) × (Total number of values)

Calculation:

∵ The average of 24 numbers = 26

∴ Sum of 24 numbers = 26 × 24

= 624

∵ The average of 1st 15 numbers = 23

∴ Sum of 1st 15 numbers = 23 × 15

= 345

∵ the the average of last 8 numbers = 33

∴ The sum of last 8 numbers = 33 × 8

= 264

∴ 16th Number = (Sum of 24 numbers) - (Sum of 1st 15 numbers + sum of last 8 numbers)

= 624 - (345 + 264)

= 624 - 609

= 15
